mapper.select: select o.order_no ,p.id,p.title,p.main_image,oi.sku_id,oi.sku_name,oi.quantity,oi.price,oi.total_price,oi.status as isRefund,oi.id as itemId from store_order_item oi left join store_product_spu p on oi.spu_id=p.id left join store_order o on oi.order_id=o.id where order_id=#{orderId};
